subject: Dryden Health — urgent: West US2 latency spike and failover request

From: Lenora Park <lenora.park@drydenhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Dryden Platform Team <ops@drydenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency & 5xx spike — West US2 traffic

Jonas,

We started seeing a sharp increase in end-user latency ~08:55 PT and a spike of 5xx errors for our inference traffic serving clinical triage from US West (us-west-2). Our dashboards show 4–5x token latency and a sustained 502/503 rate affecting ~18% of requests. This is producing timeouts in our ingestion pipeline and blocking critical workflows.

Can you confirm whether you have a regional incident? We urgently need routing shifted to another region (preferred: us-east-1) while you investigate — we cannot have degraded inference for the next 3 hours. If a manual routing override is required, please advise next steps and ETA.

Attached: dryden_kpi_jun21.png (screenshot), sample-request-ids.txt (two request ids for troubleshooting).

Lenora Park
Head of Platform
Dryden Health
lenora.park@drydenhealth.com

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:21:30 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Dryden Health — us-west-2 latency spike (canary + routing override)

Team — quick ops runbook below, we need boots on this now. Customer is experiencing significant latency and 5xxs originating in us-west-2. Dryden is a high-severity account (DH-2024-09), they require a routing shift while the region is stabilized.

Immediate plan (execute in order):
1) Create routing policy override for Dryden to prefer us-east-1; set weight to 5% initially.
2) Start canary: monitor 1-minute p50/p95/p99, error rate, and token drop. If stable for 3 consecutive minutes, increase to 25% then to 100%.
3) If canary fails, rollback to previous policy (auto fallback).
4) While canary runs, ops to collect KVCACHE metrics, GPU queue depth, and inter-AZ network stats. Attach logs to incident channel.
5) Post-shift: run a gradual drain of impacted us-west-2 nodes, and evaluate autoscaler/placement anomalies.

Attachments from customer: dryden_kpi_jun21.png, sample-request-ids.txt. I will upload our debug dump as ops-debug-20260621.txt to the incident folder.

Please confirm who will be the primary executor and post step completion messages in the incident Slack channel. Time is sensitive — customer asked for 3-hour SLA of recovery.

— Jonas
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:34:12 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Dryden Health — us-west-2 latency spike (canary + routing override)

Thanks for the clear plan, Jonas. Approving the routing override. Two asks for exec/finance:
- Approve a one-time goodwill credit (we typically do 5% for partial-hour SLA misses); given impact and potential downstream clinical effect, I’m authorizing up to 10% credit for this incident pending post-incident assessment.
- Ops: if stabilization is not achieved within 90 minutes, escalate to capacity rehoming and loop in Dedicated SREs for emergency node replacement.

Marissa/Olga — please proceed. Marissa, can you notify Customer Success to prep a short comms note indicating we’re executing a cross-region shift and will follow up with a post-incident report? Jonas — loop me in on the final PRR (post-incident review).

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Customer Success & Escalations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Severe latency & 5xx spike — West US2 traffic

Jonas / team — thank you. We saw the canary start at ~09:40 PT and performance improved as traffic moved to us-east-1. By ~09:55 PT the error rate dropped below our SLO and throughput normalized. We appreciate the fast response and the proactive routing.

Two asks:
- We need a short incident timeline and the root-cause hypothesis for our post-mortem. Please include whether this was an autoscaler/placement regression, inter-AZ network degradation, or a runtime regression.
- We'll need the mitigation plan to avoid recurrence (suggested: health-based automated divergence to alternate regions for critical customers + clarity on tenant-level fallback thresholds).

Attachments: we captured sample traces and will upload to the shared drive.

Lenora Park
Head of Platform
Dryden Health
